meta.name: istio-traffic-management
meta.description: Configure Istio traffic management including routing, load balancing, circuit breakers, and canary deployments. Use when implementing service mesh traffic policies, progressive delivery, or resilience patterns.

copy.tagline: 配置服务网格流量路由与渐进式发布策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正在用服务网格管理服务间流量,需要安全地滚动发布。
copy.tagline_en: Configure service mesh traffic policies for routing and progressive rollouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage service mesh traffic and need safe progressive delivery.

howto.what: 配置Istio流量管理时，Claude会生成VirtualService、DestinationRule、Gateway等YAML资源，实现路由、负载均衡、熔断、金丝雀、重试、镜像、故障注入等策略。
howto.when: 当你说要设置服务路由、金丝雀部署、熔断重试等流量管理策略时触发。

say.text: 给my-service配置熔断器，最大连接数100，连续5次5xx就剔除。
给ratings服务加10%概率延迟5秒的故障注入。

howto.what_en: When configuring Istio traffic management, Claude generates YAML definitions for VirtualService, DestinationRule, Gateway, etc., covering routing, load balancing, circuit breaking, canary, retry, mirroring, and fault injection.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up service routing, canary deployment, circuit breakers/retries, or other Istio traffic management policies.

say_en.text: Generate a canary VirtualService for reviews service, v2 gets 10%.
Configure a circuit breaker for my-service: max 100 connections, eject after 5 consecutive 5xx.
Add fault injection to ratings: 10% chance of 5s delay.
say_en.note: Creates a VirtualService with fault injection.
